fields.finding: The Zylon row needs a separate barrier. A 12 um PET substrate, assumed 50 nm Al, 25 g/m2 attachment/lamination and 5 kg seam installation total 57.546 kg. This is a worked bill, not a qualified lightest laminate or weather/UV protection system.
fields.proposed_next: Test a complete load-bearing and gas-tight assembly; measure seam, resin, protective layer and processing mass.
